class.name: CgameStateTree
class.brief_description: Hierarchical StateTree runtime with enter conditions, tasks, evaluators, prioritised transitions and linked subtrees.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript StateTree, in the spirit of Unreal Engine 5's StateTree. Assets are plain [Dictionary] data; behaviour is supplied through [Callable]s registered by name, which acts as a whitelist (an asset that references an unregistered name is rejected by [method validate] and [method set_asset]). [b]Asset layout:[/b] [codeblock] { "name": String, "root": String, "evaluators": [String | {"fn": String, "args": Dictionary}], "states": { id: { "children": [id], "conditions": [cond], "tasks": [task], "link": subtree_name, "transitions": [{ "trigger": "on_completed" | "on_failed" | "on_tick" | "on_event", "event": String, "condition": cond, "target": id | "$succeeded" | "$failed", "priority": int }] } } } [/codeblock] A [code]cond[/code] is a registered condition name, [code]{"fn", "args", "not"}[/code], a built-in context compare [code]{"key", "op", "value"}[/code] ([code]op[/code] is one of [code]==[/code], [code]!=[/code], [code]<[/code], [code]<=[/code], [code]>[/code], [code]>=[/code]) or an [Array] of conditions that must all pass. A [code]task[/code] is a registered task name or [code]{"fn", "args"}[/code]. A state without tasks never completes by itself. [b]Selection:[/b] from the root, the first child (depth first) whose enter conditions pass; a state with children but no selectable child is not selectable. When a transition fires, the highest [code]priority[/code] wins, then the deepest state, then declaration order. [b]Linked subtrees:[/b] a state with [code]"link"[/code] gets the subtree's root as its last child. Subtree states are namespaced as [code]"<linking state>/<id>"[/code]. [b]Callable signatures:[/b] - Task [code]enter(ctx: Dictionary, params: Dictionary)[/code], [code]tick(ctx: Dictionary, dt: float, params: Dictionary) -> int[/code] (a [enum Status] value) and [code]exit(ctx: Dictionary, params: Dictionary)[/code]. [code]params[/code] is the task's [code]args[/code] plus [code]"_state"[/code] (the id of the owning state). - Condition [code](ctx: Dictionary, args: Dictionary) -> bool[/code]. - Evaluator [code](ctx: Dictionary, dt: float, args: Dictionary) -> Dictionary[/code]; a returned dictionary is merged into [code]ctx[/code]. While [code]on_event[/code] transitions are evaluated the context temporarily holds [code]_event[/code] and [code]_event_payload[/code]. The context [Dictionary] is shared by reference, so callables can mutate it directly.

method.name: current_state
method.description: Returns the id of the active leaf state, or an empty string when inactive.

method.name: debug_path
method.description: Returns the active path joined with [code]/[/code], or [code]"(inactive)"[/code].

method.name: get_active_path
method.description: Returns the ids of the active states from the root down to the leaf. See also [member active_path].

method.name: get_errors
method.description: Returns the validation errors of the last [method set_asset] call. See also [member errors].

method.name: get_trace
method.description: Returns the recorded [code]"enter:id"[/code] / [code]"exit:id"[/code] entries. See also [member trace].

method.name: get_tree_status
method.description: Returns the status of the tree. See also [member tree_status].

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param state_id] is on the active path.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the tree is running. See also [member running].

method.name: register_condition
method.description: Registers a condition [Callable] [code](ctx: Dictionary, args: Dictionary) -> bool[/code] under [param name].

method.name: register_evaluator
method.description: Registers an evaluator [Callable] [code](ctx: Dictionary, dt: float, args: Dictionary) -> Dictionary[/code] under [param name]. Evaluators listed in the asset run at the start of every [method tick].

method.name: register_subtree
method.description: Registers a subtree asset that states can reference with [code]"link"[/code]. Register subtrees before [method set_asset].

method.name: register_task
method.description: Registers a task under [param name]. [param enter], [param tick] and [param exit] are all optional; a task without [param tick] never completes on its own.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Queues an event for the next [method tick]. Events are delivered to [code]on_event[/code] transitions whose [code]event[/code] equals [param name].

method.name: set_asset
method.description: Validates, flattens linked subtrees and installs [param asset]. Returns [code]false[/code] on error; see [member errors].

method.name: start
method.description: Resets the runtime and selects the initial path, running the enter callables outer to inner. Returns [code]false[/code] when no asset is installed or no state is selectable (the tree status becomes [constant FAILED] in the latter case).

method.name: stop
method.description: Exits the active path from the leaf outward and stops the tree.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the tree: runs evaluators, delivers queued events, ticks the tasks of the active states, then resolves [code]on_completed[/code] / [code]on_failed[/code] (from the innermost finished state outward) and [code]on_tick[/code] transitions. When a state completed or failed and nothing handles it, the tree finishes with [constant SUCCEEDED] or [constant FAILED]. Returns the resulting tree status.

method.name: validate
method.description: Validates [param asset] against the registered tasks, conditions, evaluators and subtrees. Checks the root, children, transition triggers and targets, conditions, hierarchy cycles and recursive links (depth is limited to [constant MAX_LINK_DEPTH]). Returns the list of error strings; an empty array means the asset is valid.

members.member: The ids of the active states from the root down to the leaf. Read only.
Validation errors of the last [method set_asset] call. Read only.
[code]true[/code] while the tree is running. Read only.
Trace of enter/exit calls ([code]"enter:id"[/code] / [code]"exit:id"[/code]) for debugging and tests. Cleared with [method clear_trace]. Read only.
Status of the tree: [constant RUNNING] while active, otherwise the final [constant SUCCEEDED] or [constant FAILED]. Read only.

The task, state or tree completed successfully.
The task, state or tree failed.
